The '''Imperial medical service''' was a division of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It oversaw medical matters, such as being the public face of the Empire's efforts to combat the [[FNV-23|plague]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sedesia]].
